integrity: The proof uses exact linear jet constraints, arbitrary-degree rank analysis, a genus-zero Pluecker formula, and S3 orbit structure; limited symbolic computations are supplemental rather than infinite proofs. The mathematical argument received self-review only.
scientific_limitations: The Wronskian is that of the plane-form linear system pulled back to the normalization of the unique three-cusped rational plane quartic over C, not an intrinsic singular-curve pluricanonical Wronskian; the characteristic-zero and m>=2 hypotheses are essential. The m=2 unrefined count of three sextactic points is classically known. Historical priority of the complete all-degree divisor is provisional.
title: All-degree ramification of the tricuspidal plane quartic
